title: Cloud Security: lifecycle fees
content:
Cloud Security handling of lifecycle fees is governed by these handling clauses.

## Handling basis

This fee branch applies only to setup, resumption, termination and bank-return fee source subtype.

Charge setup fee once for an activated holding, resumption fee per distinct completed restoration, on-demand termination fee for on-demand exit, and bank-return fee per completed bank return.

An unexpired commitment exit instead bills the recorded remaining signed commitment liability in USD as its termination liability.

Copy the exact source transition, customer authorization or bank notice reference; do not use a primary meter as fee evidence.

A zero fee is waived without a financial event.

The fee amount is the selected policy amount or recorded signed liability, rounded using monetary decimal precision and rounding convention, then taxed under the tax basis.

The primary-usage branch of the primary usage pricing basis and its posted primary meter gate apply only to source subtype primary; supplemental charges use the category meter policy.

Already billed source occurrence and fee subtype make repetition read-only.

## Basis Q&A

**What happens when the same fee source has already been billed?**

Already billed source occurrence and fee subtype make repetition read-only.

## Waived occurrence fee

Hypothetical case: a completed restoration has a selected fee of zero. The fee is waived without a financial event.
